components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call to action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 42px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--accent, #43D48D); color: var(--accent-ink, #04140C); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12) inset, 0 8px 22px -10px var(--accent-tint, rgba(67,212,141,.15)); transition: .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #2CB975); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #43D48D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 42px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--surface, #131516); color: var(--text, #F2F4F2); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,.085)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4); transition: .16s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(255,255,255,.18)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #43D48D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Citation Pill
components.description: The product's signature: an inline, clickable page reference dropped next to any sourced fact.
components.html: p.148
components.css: .ds-cite { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--accent-tint, rgba(67,212,141,.15)); color: var(--accent, #43D48D); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; padding: 1.5px 7px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: .13s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-cite:hover { background: var(--accent, #43D48D); color: var(--accent-ink, #04140C); } .ds-cite:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #43D48D); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: FinLens looks like the work of someone who has already checked twice. The system is restrained everywhere except the one place that matters: the exact page a fact came from. A tempered serif (Fraunces) carries the authority of a printed report; a plain, humanist sans (Instrument Sans) carries the actual work of reading and deciding; a monospace (JetBrains Mono) marks anything that is data, a number, or a source — so the eye learns to trust mono text as "this has been verified." The emerald accent is rare on purpose: it marks the one action, the one flagged number, the one citation pill per fact, never a whole surface. Dark "ink" panels (sidebar, hero, CTA bands) are a fixed signature that does not follow the light/dark theme toggle — the auditor's notebook stays the same color regardless of what time you're reading it.
keyCharacteristics: Two-register typography: serif for authority, mono for anything sourced or numeric.
One accent color, spent almost exclusively on the citation pill and the primary action.
Fixed dark "ink" panels as a brand signature independent of theme.
Flat surfaces lifted only by soft, low-contrast shadows — never a hard drop shadow.
Pills (100px radius) for anything the user scans as a tag: badges, chips, citations, quick-search suggestions.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Verified Emerald appears on at most one primary action and the citation pills per view — never as a section background or a decorative sweep.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink Rule
rules.body: Sidebar, public hero, and CTA bands stay on the dark ink palette in both light and dark theme.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Sourced Rule
rules.body: If a number or short reference is set in JetBrains Mono, it must be traceable to a document or a live computation.

rules.name: The No Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is soft, wide-spread, and low-opacity. A crisp, close, high-contrast shadow anywhere in the UI is a bug, not a variant.

dos: Do put a citation pill or source card next to every generated number or claim.
Do keep the sidebar, public hero, and CTA bands on the fixed ink palette in both themes.
Do use mono type only for numbers, dates, and references that are actually sourced or computed.
Do use soft, wide, low-opacity shadows for any elevation; scale strength down, not off, in the light theme.
donts: Don't use the emerald accent as a section background, gradient, or decorative sweep.
Don't apply a hard, close, high-contrast drop shadow anywhere.
Don't use JetBrains Mono decoratively for numerals that aren't traceable to a document or a live computation.
